label: Update gate high when observer believes S2 is good, low when S1; strongest at GO.
terms: (phase == GO) * np.tanh(belief_lo) ;; (phase == D1) * np.tanh(belief_lo) ;; (phase == GO) * (belief_lo > 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (belief_lo > 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == GO)*(prev_reward==1)*(prev_action==prev_state)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 15 is a graded, saturating readout of the ideal observer belief about which state is good: near 1 when S2 is believed good (a2-favoured), dropping toward ~0.1-0.3 when S1 is believed good, with the swing about twice as large at GO as at D1 and almost none at D2 (saturated near 1). A smaller extra drop at D1/GO when the previous choice was a1 captures part of the last-trial pattern table. The free fit adds belief sign steps, previous state and a common-rewarded term at GO for a modest gain. Not driven by future reward or time since reversal.

issues: The label leaves out the third short-form term: an extra drop at D1 and GO after an a1 choice (weight -0.14). It is worth about 0.03 test R^2 (0.606 without it, 0.637 with it). It also says nothing about D2, where the gate stays pinned near 1 (D2 residuals are only ±0.06 across belief deciles).

Misses show some systematic leftover error, but well below the size of the main effect. GO after a1 S2 r is under-predicted by +0.275 and GO after a2 S2 u by +0.23; D1 after a1 S2 u is over-predicted by -0.22 and D1 after a1 S2 r by -0.15. The worst-fit windows are lags after the observer's belief flips, where the gate stays low for several trials after the switch to a2 and the observer's belief does not capture that.

No variant I tried beat the recorded short form on test: two-back action 0.636; a single belief term scaled up at GO 0.636; a1-unrewarded 0.636; D1-only prev a1 0.617; D1 last_is('a1 S2 u') 0.628; belief sign instead of tanh at GO 0.550; scaled by belief_cover 0.561.

The claims check out. The GO belief swing is about twice the D1 swing (weights -0.35 vs -0.16). Dropping the prev-a1 term gives 0.606, so belief carries most of the fit. Future reward and since_rev reference scores are 0. The form uses no future variables.
